messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-api` (latency_slo_burn). Trigger: p99 >= 2200ms for 10m. PD incident: PD-4498. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/latency-slo

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-4498 created and notifications sent to `eng-oncall` schedule. Escalation policy: primary -> secondary -> manager.

sam: Acked. I'm on primary. Jumping into traces now. Will post findings.

jess: Thanks sam — tagging priya as well since she pushed the recent model rollout this morning. @priya can you take a look at model routing config?

priya: Looking. I see a spike in p99 across us-west-2 and eu-west-1 starting ~08:12 UTC. Correlates with a canary rollout to v3-quantized-rc (20% traffic). KV cache miss rate jumped ~3x.

david: Noted customer impact: batch embedding jobs could be delayed (high severity for scheduled pipelines). Interactive chat has increased tail latency but streaming still ok for many users. Estimated % of traffic affected ~18%.

sam: Throwing quick queries to collector and tracer: `curl -s "https://collector.internal/api/queries?service=inference-api&interval=10m" | jq .` shows increased `kv_cache_miss` and `kernel_queue_wait_ms` on g4dn nodes.

priya: I'm going to rollback the canary to 0% and re-route canary traffic to fallback model v2-stable. Steps: 1) pin traffic weights, 2) scale up fallback if needed, 3) monitor p99. Executing now.

priya: ```
# rollback canary
redwoodctl rollout set-weight --service inference-api --model v3-quantized-rc --weight 0
redwoodctl rollout set-weight --service inference-api --model v2-stable --weight 100
kubectl get pods -l app=inference-api -o wide
```

incident-bot: Action recorded: `redwoodctl rollout` command executed by priya at 08:25 UTC.

sam: Saw model weights change. p99 dropping in eu-west-1 now, us-west still high but trending down. KV cache hit-rate improving after traffic swap.

jess: Good. Priya, after we stabilize can we open a postmortem runway item to investigate why quantized variant increases kernel queue wait? Might be a memory access pattern issue or suboptimal kernel selection.

priya: Agreed. Creating incident ticket: INC-2026 with notes and attaching traces. Will include rollout commands and traces.

priya: Also creating a temporary autoscale bump for node pool in us-west-2 to relieve queue pressure: `terraform apply -var "node_pool_size=20" -target=module.inference.node_pool` (will revert after stabilization).

sre-bot: autoscale request accepted, provisioning 4 additional g4dn nodes. Estimated ready in ~4m.

sam: Monitoring logs: errors count stable (no increase in 5xx), so likely perf regression rather than correctness. Customer-facing retries minimal.

david: Communicating to support: "We observed elevated tail latency impacting some batch and interactive users in specific regions. Engineers are actively mitigating; we expect improvement within 15 minutes. No data loss."

priya: p99 back to baseline in eu-west and eu-central. us-west 95th percentile still borderline. Autoscale nodes coming up.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-4498 status updated -> acknowledged by sam. Escalation suppressed.

jess: Oncall handoff note: I'll stay on until we hit steady state and then hand to night oncall (david) at 09:15 UTC. Priya please add short remediation steps in INC-2026.

priya: Added remediation checklist to INC-2026: (1) revert model routing, (2) validate kernel selection telemetry, (3) add canary circuit-breaker threshold to block high-kv-miss rollouts.

sam: p99 in us-west dropped to 1.1s -> within SLO window for now. Marking the incident as "mitigated" in chat but keeping PD open until postmortem.

incident-bot: PD-4498 marked as mitigated by sam at 08:47 UTC.

david: Taking over monitoring and follow-ups. I'll keep PD open for investigation, will coordinate with research for kernel repro. Handing off to night oncall @katie later.

jess: Great work team. Quick retrospectives: 1) fail-fast canary rollback automation, 2) pre-rollout KV cache warmup for quantized variants, 3) alert tuning to include kv_cache_miss spike as an early signal.

priya: Will schedule a short post-incident sync 30m after stabilization to capture action items.

sam: Closing notes: no customer SLA breaches detected at account level; internal SLO burn recorded ~12% for the 30m window. Saving traces and logs to INC-2026. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Thread closed by priya. Follow-up tasks created: INC-2026, PMR-127.
